Competitions.empty: Challenge results will be published once provided by the league.

skills.title: From an idea to a strategy that competes
skills.description: A systematic investment strategy goes through the same stages, whether in a challenge or at a quantitative asset manager.

thesis.title: Thesis
thesis.body: A clear hypothesis about where the return comes from, one that can be tested with data.

data.title: Data
data.body: Collecting, cleaning and organizing the price series and indicators that feed the model.

backtest.title: Backtest
backtest.body: Simulating the strategy on history, with costs, to measure return, risk and robustness.

risk.title: Risk
risk.body: Setting position sizes, limits and what to do when the market turns against the thesis.

skills.capital: See these stages in practice at FGV Quant Capital, the league's simulated fund.
